The test image shows dense, fibrous white/gray mycelium covering plant tissue, with dark specks scattered throughout. This looks fungal — top candidates: Gray Mold, Sclerotinia Timber Rot, Rhizopus Soft Rots, Southern Blight, Powdery Mildew.

Let me view one reference from each top candidate class.

The evidence is clear. The test image (Bugwood ID 5369123) is consecutive with Rhizopus reference images 5369128 and 5369129 — same photo series. The dense white/gray fibrous mycelium with dark specks in the test image corresponds to Rhizopus sporangia visible at lower magnification in the references.
